name: ParametricNoise algebra (source, blend, add, multiply, interpolate, mask, channel ops)
plain: A set of lazy NOISE objects that only compute when the sampler asks for the initial noise, so shape comes from the real latent. Blend defaults to slerp (direction on the sphere, magnitude interpolated linearly); screen, overlay and soft_light are done after mapping both noises through the normal CDF to (0,1), then mapped back and mean-centred. MaskComposite divides the feathered crossfade by its own standard deviation at each pixel so the seam keeps unit variance. Surprise: Multiply with no second noise and normalize on (the default) renormalizes the scaled noise straight back to unit variance, so its gain only changes the sign.
math:
Symbols: a, b input noises; w weight; m mask in [0,1]; ρ measured correlation of a and b; N(·) per-channel zero-mean unit-std.
slerp(a,b,w) per batch item on flattened vectors: θ=acos(â·b̂); dir = sin((1−w)θ)/sinθ·â + sin(wθ)/sinθ·b̂; out = dir·((1−w)|a|+w|b|); lerp when sinθ≈0.
Photographic modes: u_a=Φ(a), u_b=(1−w)Φ(a)+wΦ(b); u=mode(u_a,u_b); out=Φ⁻¹(u) − mean.
Add: a+g·b, then N(·) by default. Multiply: a·b·g (or a·g), then N(·) by default.
Interpolate: t∈[0,N−1] picks pair i=floor(t), slerp or lerp with frac.
MaskComposite (slerp): ((1−m)a + m b)/√((1−m)²+m²+2m(1−m)ρ); other modes blend a toward mode(a,b) the same way.
ChannelOps on chosen channels: gain, offset, zero, isolate, shuffle (seeded perm), swap pairs.

props.normalizes_variance: slerp and mask composite by construction; add and multiply renormalize by default; lerp does not
props.params: Blend weight 0.5 mode slerp; Add gain 1, normalize on; Multiply gain 1, normalize on; Interpolate t 0.5 slerp; MaskComposite feather 4, slerp; Source distribution gaussian|uniform|laplace|cauchy|logistic
